headline: Japanese Yen Surges as Global Risk Aversion Spurs Safe-Haven Demand
summary: The Japanese yen rose 0.8% against the dollar to 156.86, hitting its strongest level since late September amidst a broader flight from risk.
why: The yen is widely used as a safe-haven currency during periods of global financial market distress and risk aversion.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Global risk aversion prompts investors to shift capital into safe-haven currencies like the yen.

why_moved: Widespread flight from risk across global markets triggered strong demand for safe-haven assets.
